description: This file defines the code-behind for the registration page in an ASP.NET Core Identity-based web application. It manages user registration, including form handling, user creation, email confirmation, and sign-in processes.

classes.name: RegisterModel
classes.description: PageModel class handling user registration logic, including validation, user creation, email confirmation, and sign-in.

classes.name: InputModel
classes.description: Data transfer object representing the registration form inputs, including email, password, and confirmation password.

methods.name: OnGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to load the registration page, optionally setting the return URL.

methods.name: OnPostAsync
methods.description: Handles POST requests for user registration, performs validation, creates user accounts, sends confirmation email, and signs in the user upon success.
